description: List, add, update or delete products in a shop website. Price is a whole-number amount in the store currency. Pass several imageUrls to build the product gallery/slideshow (first = main image; use manage_media to host external images first) and videoUrls (YouTube) for product videos. Responses include a viewUrl/viewLink to the live product page once published — share them as clickable markdown links. bulk_update accepts status, categoryTop/categorySub, price, stockQty, and description across many productIds at once (SKU is not bulk-editable — it must be unique per product, use update for that). Variants (size/colour) are managed with manage_variants; bulk imports with product_csv.

imageUrls.description: Image URLs in display order — first is the main image. On update this REPLACES the gallery.

importedOnly.description: mirror_images: true mirrors only imported products; false scans selected/all products. Default true.

maxImages.description: mirror_images: maximum remote images to copy into Social AI storage, default 100, max 500.

price.description: add (required) / update: whole number in store currency, e.g. 499

videoUrls.description: YouTube URLs for the product page (watch/share/shorts links all work). On update this REPLACES the videos.

name: manage_products
